One pair is descriptive; order and provider variance prevent causal latency or reliable tail claims
Original-source repair is required; later model repairs occur only after known deterministic test failure and within the fixed grant
Requested/applied settings are distinct from effective provider settings; missing observations remain unknown
Initial fixture setup and grant are synthetic test data, not actual-company or founder authorization
No detached autonomous scheduler claim; the harness calls real dispatch, worker, test and acceptance paths
